title: 4-beauty
approach: A 4-term AP realises only the divisibility pairs (1,2),(1,3),(1,4),(2,4), so the 4-beauty is always 4 and only {a,2a,3a,4a} attains it — making this a min-weight hitting set over all {a,2a,3a,4a} with 4a <= n. Numbers split into independent groups q*2^i*3^j; a DP along the doubling chains with the chain's removal pattern as a bitmask (plus a superset-min transform between chain m and 3m) solves it.

techniques.label: bitmask-dp
techniques.why: the removal pattern of a chain is a bitmask

techniques.label: hitting-set
techniques.why: the problem reduces to min-weight hitting set

verified: exhaustive removal-subset brute force equals the hitting-set model on all 4 samples; the chain DP matched brute force on 400 random instances
